30 years, we have focused on the active management of liquid capital market investments in the areas of fixed income, equity, and multi-asset solutions. More than 20 portfolio managers, risk managers, and ESG specialists leverage their excellent expertise to create tailored solutions, working with our clients as partners who truly understand their needs. In addition to traditional investment approaches, our service offering is complemented by forecast-free, rule-based investment strategies for liquid asset classes with risk overlay concepts, as well as select liquid alternative strategies.
